definition: Saturates F report a realizes every value of the supplied report domain V as report w at some F-accessible world from a. The general law identifies necessary report constraints with constraints true at every domain value, conditional on saturation. This is report surjectivity, not a claim that all propositions are independently elementary or all value assignments genuinely metaphysically possible.
